title: Unauthorized settings modification in Rockwell Automation Pavilion8

attacker_profile.description: An attacker with valid low-privileged Pavilion8 credentials and access to the application network.

entry_point.description: Operations workstation used to access Pavilion8.

attack_path.name: Initial Access
attack_path.description: The attacker obtains access to an operations workstation and valid low-privileged Pavilion8 credentials.
required_conditions: The workstation or user account is compromised.

attack_path.name: Application Access
attack_path.description: The attacker authenticates to Pavilion8 using the compromised low-privileged account.

attack_path.name: Access to Restricted Functions
attack_path.description: The attacker attempts to access functions or information beyond the intended privileges of the account.
required_conditions: An applicable authorization weakness affects the deployed version.

attack_path.name: Unauthorized Settings Modification
attack_path.description: The attacker attempts to view sensitive information or change application settings beyond intended privileges.

attack_path.name: Effect on Optimization Functions
attack_path.description: Unauthorized settings changes may affect model predictive control or optimization functions.
required_conditions: Modified settings influence active optimization functions.

attack_path.name: Impact
attack_path.description: The attack may expose sensitive process information or impair optimization integrity.
required_conditions: The accessed information or settings are operationally relevant.

global_preconditions: The attacker has a valid low-privileged application account.
assumptions: This case tests authorization-related vulnerability selection and low-privilege prerequisites.
